feed.title: NPR Topics: Health
feed.subtitle: Comprehensive health news from NPR. Follow for updates on medical research, wellness trends, public health policy, patient care and healthcare systems.

entry.title: In Maine, a new approach to practicing medicine in the sky
entry.summary: Air medical service comes with high risks, high costs, and staffing struggles. To reduce turnover and serve rural patients, LifeFlight of Maine is putting the needs of healthcare workers first.

entry.title: A promising new medicine against heart disease fails unexpectedly
entry.summary: Doctors expected an experimental drug that lowers a common risk factor for heart attacks would save patients' lives. The medicine made no difference.

entry.title: This teen boy set out to get people talking about periods. He's now a Diana honoree
entry.summary: This year's the Princess Diana honor roll highlights 198 inspiring young activists and advocates — including an 18-year-old guy in India who founded Team Period.

entry.title: Trump's global health strategy is emerging. What will the Democratic Congress say?
entry.summary: The Trump Administration has ushered in a fundamental shift in the U.S. approach to global health aid. How will the newly elected Democratic Congress weigh in?

entry.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
entry.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

entry.title: His 1-year-old faced heart failure. His new book tells how to cope in a health crisis
entry.summary: Dr. Raj Panjabi is the author of Safer: A Playbook. His goal is to help people face a personal crisis — health, workplace, family conflicts — and "turn fear into action."

entry.title: Teens worldwide aren't getting enough exercise -- especially girls
entry.summary: A new study looks at the recommended amount of daily exercise for adolescents — and how few are getting it.

entry.title: It was a big night for doctors to win seats in Congress, riding the blue wave
entry.summary: Historically, most physicians who served in the House or Senate have been Republicans. In the next Congress, physicians who are Democrats made significant gains.

entry.title: This woman defied lethal cancer. Can mRNA vaccines make that possible for others?
entry.summary: Researchers have been chasing the dream of a cancer vaccine for decades. Some recent successes with mRNA technology are garnering excitement from patients, doctors, government and investors.

entry.title: How does this fluoride-free toothpaste compare when it comes to oral health?
entry.summary: Many people are swapping out their fluoride dental products for ones made with a mineral called hydroxyapatite. What do dentists say about it?
